rubric.description: 1-10 Fellow Performance Rubric used by DeepThought psychology interns

1-2.label: Non-Functional
1-2.description: Fellow is not showing up, not engaging, or actively causing harm. No positive behavioral evidence.

3-4.label: Below Expectations
3-4.description: Fellow is present but passive. Takes instructions but does not initiate. Supervisor has low confidence. Little to no systems building visible.

5-6.label: Functional
5-6.description: Fellow is reliable and productive. Completes assigned tasks. Some initiative visible. Supervisor is satisfied but not impressed. Limited evidence of beyond-role behavior.

7-8.label: Strong
7-8.description: Fellow is proactive, trusted, and building visible systems. Supervisor references Fellow unprompted. Evidence of ownership, cross-functional coordination, and team behavior change.

9-10.label: Exceptional
9-10.description: Fellow is operating at a level beyond the role. Supervisor gives strong unprompted endorsements. Clear evidence of lasting systems, behavior change in others, and measurable business impact.
